items.description: Field Journal · 🌲 The Whispering Woods

components.content:
You find Maren mid-sentence, talking to her Barkley about something it clearly already knows.

She doesn't look up immediately.

When she does: *'Oh good. Another one. Sit down — Barkley, move over — and tell me what you've seen so far.'*



You tell her you're just starting.



*'Good,'* she says. *'Then you haven't learned any bad habits yet. I'm writing a new page of the Bestiary — the server's record of what exists here, officially. For that I need firsthand accounts. Not mine. I've been here too long. I see what I expect to see.'*



*'Go out three times. Pick a path you want to know better. Catch three companions and tell me what meeting them felt like. That's the part that goes in the record.'*

**0/3** · Explore three times; choose your destination with /explore

embed.description:
*The Loom's First Memory*
A chubby little hamster woven out of glowing crimson thread, with a tiny clock gear ticking softly on its back like a shell. Twine carries the very first thread the Loom ever spun — which is why, sometimes, it seems to know what happens a few seconds before it does.
